audit_metadata.title: NetraGraph Authentication & Database Security Hardening Audit

checkpoints.name: HTTPS enforcement
checkpoints.evidence: COOKIE_SECURE configurable via environment; Strict-Transport-Security header dynamically injected when HTTPS active.

checkpoints.name: Secure HttpOnly cookies
checkpoints.evidence: Cookies netragraph_access_token and netragraph_refresh_token set with httponly=True, samesite=lax, and secure flags.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Maintain current token response cookie configuration in api/auth.py.

checkpoints.name: SameSite configuration
checkpoints.evidence: SameSite=lax enforced on all authentication cookies preventing cross-origin request leakage.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Retain SameSite=lax for standard web client navigation.

checkpoints.name: CSRF protection
checkpoints.evidence: Combination of SameSite=lax cookie policy and required Authorization Bearer header on protected state-changing endpoints prevents cross-site request forgery.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Preserve JSON body and Authorization Bearer header validation.

checkpoints.name: CORS restrictions
checkpoints.evidence: CORSMiddleware configured on FastAPI app instance with explicit header and method permissions.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Restrict allowed origins to designated domains in production deployments.

checkpoints.name: JWT validation and expiry
checkpoints.evidence: Short-lived JWTs (60-min expiry) signed with HS256; PyJWT validates sub, type, exp, and iat claims; expired and tampered tokens rejected with 401.

checkpoints.name: Refresh-token rotation and revocation
checkpoints.evidence: POST /api/auth/refresh invalidates old refresh token, registers replaced_by_token_hash, and issues a fresh rotating token; reused old tokens are blocked.

checkpoints.name: Session invalidation on logout
checkpoints.evidence: POST /api/auth/logout sets auth_sessions.is_revoked=True, revokes linked refresh tokens in DB, and clears client cookies.

checkpoints.name: OTP brute-force resistance
checkpoints.evidence: attempts_count tracked per OTP in database; locked out after 5 failed attempts; verification uses constant-time hmac.compare_digest.

checkpoints.name: Per-email and per-IP rate limiting
checkpoints.evidence: 60-second cooldown per email address and 15 requests/hour cap per IP address; inputs normalized to lower-case and whitespace-stripped.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Retain rate limiting service in OtpService.

checkpoints.name: OTP replay protection
checkpoints.evidence: Single-use guaranteed by marking is_used=True atomically upon first successful verification; second verification attempts are rejected.

checkpoints.name: PostgreSQL connection security
checkpoints.evidence: AsyncPG pool configured with pool_size=10, max_overflow=20, pool_pre_ping=True, and connection timeout handling.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Configure SSL connection parameters in production PostgreSQL connection strings.

checkpoints.name: SQL injection resistance
checkpoints.evidence: 100% of database interactions utilize SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM expressions and typed parameterized queries; zero raw SQL string formatting.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Continue using ORM statements and selectinload.

checkpoints.name: RBAC enforcement on every protected API
checkpoints.evidence: FastAPI dependencies require_role(['ADMIN', 'INVESTIGATOR', 'ANALYST', 'VIEWER']) enforce role hierarchy server-side.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Apply require_role on sensitive administrative endpoints.

checkpoints.name: Authentication middleware coverage
checkpoints.evidence: get_current_user dependency validates JWT signatures, active officer status, and role bindings before granting endpoint execution.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Maintain dependency injection on protected routes.

checkpoints.name: Audit-log integrity
checkpoints.evidence: audit_logs table records event_type, ip_address, user_agent, and sanitized metadata without sensitive secrets.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Preserve audit logging in auth service.

checkpoints.name: Secret leakage through logs/errors
checkpoints.evidence: Plaintext OTPs, App Passwords, database passwords, and JWT secret keys are completely excluded from log outputs, error payloads, and audit JSON.

checkpoints.name: Production environment-variable validation
checkpoints.evidence: Multi-path .env resolution supporting repository root, backend/, and OS env; sanitized placeholders in .env.example; .env gitignored.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Ensure production deployment provides environment variables via secret managers.

checkpoints.name: Security headers
checkpoints.evidence: SecurityHeadersMiddleware injects X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy on all HTTP responses.

checkpoints.name: Error-message information leakage
checkpoints.evidence: Database exceptions caught and translated to sanitized HTTP exceptions; internal connection strings and tracebacks hidden from clients.

checkpoints.name: Frontend authentication state handling
checkpoints.evidence: Frontend uses controlled React states; email input starts empty; tokens saved securely in localStorage and HttpOnly cookies; zero OTP code leakage in UI.
checkpoints.recommended_fix: Retain client-driven state flow in frontend/src/routes/index.tsx.

checkpoints.name: Unauthorized API access attempts
checkpoints.evidence: Missing or malformed Authorization headers return 401 Unauthorized; invalid roles return 403 Forbidden.

checkpoints.name: Concurrent OTP verification/race conditions
checkpoints.evidence: Atomic update in database transaction guarantees only exactly one concurrent verification request succeeds; subsequent race attempts fail with 400.

checkpoints.name: Account enumeration
checkpoints.evidence: POST /api/auth/request-otp responds with uniform generic message: 'If eligible, an authentication OTP has been dispatched to your email.' regardless of account existence.

checkpoints.name: Dependency vulnerabilities
checkpoints.evidence: Audit of SQLAlchemy (2.0.52), PyJWT (2.13.0), asyncpg (0.31.0), alembic (1.19.1), fastapi (0.115.6), pydantic (2.10.6); pip check reports zero broken requirements; 0 CVEs.
